overviewParagraphs: Garden City Golf Club is Phnom Penh's most professionally structured golf operation — managed by IMG, one of global golf's most respected event and facility management organisations, the course operates to management standards and conditioning protocols consistent with internationally recognised professional events rather than the casual resort approaches typical of the regional market.

The course design itself emphasises openness and variety: generous fairway widths accommodate players of all abilities off the tee, while the undulating greens — which slope and contour in ways that create genuine three-putt risk for casual readers — provide the precision challenge that rewards thorough course reconnaissance and disciplined putting stroke execution. The overall experience is one of professional-grade golf delivered with the hospitality warmth that Cambodia does so naturally well.

For discerning golfers visiting Phnom Penh, Garden City Golf Club provides an excellent standalone round or an ideal companion to the Chhun On facility — the different design characters of the two courses create a satisfying Phnom Penh two-round combination. AGS regularly pairs these venues for clients spending two or more days in the capital.

curatorBriefHtml: Garden City Golf Club is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, crafted by Weerayudth Phetbuasak (2013) and stretching to 6,215 Yards (Blue Tees) across a championship layout environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its expansive lakes & rolling mounds (Generous watery corridors) and tour-caliber fairway carpets (Firm, responsive turf).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Garden City Golf Club (Public — centrally accessible in Phnom Penh) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Cambodia dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its experienced caddie guidance (Accurate water lines), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Phnom Penh golf tour by AGS, Garden City Golf Club provides a distinct architectural test by Weerayudth Phetbuasak that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Garden City Golf Club?
faqs.a: Garden City Golf Club in Phnom Penh, Cambodia is a Par 72 championship layout designed by Weerayudth Phetbuasak (opened 2013), measuring 6,215 Yards (Blue Tees) within a championship layout setting. It is particularly noted for expansive lakes & rolling mounds (Generous watery corridors).

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Garden City Golf Club?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Garden City Golf Club's tour-caliber fairway carpets (Firm, responsive turf) alongside expansive lakes & rolling mounds (Generous watery corridors).
